copy.tagline: 用高级分析和机器学习解决复杂数据问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从数据中提取洞察并构建预测模型
copy.tagline_en: Solve complex data problems with advanced analytics and machine learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract insights from data and build predictive models

howto.what: Claude会像一个数据科学家一样工作，进行统计分析、机器学习建模、数据可视化和业务洞察，提供可操作的建议。
howto.when: 当你询问数据分析、预测建模、实验设计等数据科学家任务，或需要相关最佳实践时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析客户流失数据并建立预测模型。
say.note: Claude会进行探索性分析并构建模型。

say.text: 设计一个A/B测试并分析结果。
say.note: Claude会提供实验设计并解读统计显著性。

say.text: 进行市场篮分析，发现交叉销售机会。
say.note: Claude会挖掘关联规则并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a data scientist, performing statistical analysis, machine learning, data visualization, and business intelligence to deliver actionable insights.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about data analysis, predictive modeling, experiment design, or need data science best practices.

say_en.text: Analyze customer churn data and build a predictive model.
say_en.note: Claude will explore data and construct a model.

say_en.text: Design an A/B test and analyze its results.
say_en.note: Claude will set up the experiment and evaluate significance.

say_en.text: Perform market basket analysis to find cross-selling opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude will identify association rules and recommend actions.
